item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00340","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C05","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.74,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C06 plausibly supplied a material structural template for reallocating an administrative program between agencies: it identifies the affected jurisdiction, assigns the relevant powers to a new official, preserves or limits prior authorities, and fixes an effective date. The child adapts that machinery to disability retirement pay and hospitalization, repeatedly vesting duties, powers, and functions in specified Secretaries or the Veterans' Administrator while adding exceptions and savings clauses. C05 is also a strong transfer-of-functions analogue, but its structure is less closely matched to the child's extensive allocation and preservation provisions. C24 concerns the same 1949 statute and uniformed services but primarily supplies related subject-matter vocabulary rather than the child's central transfer machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"all duties, powers, and functions incident to the payment of disability retirement pay ... shall ... be vested in the Secretary concerned","parent_excerpt":"The Attorney General is hereby authorized and directed to take such action as he may deem necessary with respect to any property or interest","explanation":"Both provisions move operational authority over a defined administrative subject to a designated official."},{"child_excerpt":"nothing in this order shall be construed to affect the duties, powers, and functions of the Public Health Service","parent_excerpt":"nothing in this order shall be deemed to limit or remove any powers heretofore conferred upon the Secretary of the Treasury or the Attorney General","explanation":"Both use a substantive savings clause to preserve authority outside the transfer."},{"child_excerpt":"Effective July 1, 1950 ... thereafter the Veterans' Administration shall not be charged ... with any further responsibility","parent_excerpt":"This order shall become effective as of midnight, September 30, 1948","explanation":"Both couple the jurisdictional reassignment to a precise transition date."}]}
